comment: The class was the right amount of challenging, and Dr. Stone made it easy to understand and enjoyable with his great sense of humor. He really cares about his students and is always there to help. He clearly explains what will be on the exam and how to prepare to get an A. I learned a lot in his Services Marketing class and definitely recommend him
Nicest guy ever!!! easy a class too if you pay attention. Info is kind of common sense but it's interesting, i learned a lot

dr. stone is an amazing guy, truely cares about his students, very helpful outside of class, and is very goofy with a great sense of humor.  has a tendency to ramble on, causing you to lose focus and wonder what the hell hes talking about, but overall a great great guy.

Teaches directly from book and overheads. Take notes and memorize and the A is yours. This class is NOT hard -- if you put a decent effort into it. He's a great guy. Funny, friendly, approachable. VERY VERY clear. Maybe the clearest professor I've ever had in my life. Clear expectations, clear teaching. TAKE THIS MAN'S CLASS!
